RWA.note: Document states no AI rule or authority.
Document states no government use of AI.
DoctorAI is a startup's product for clinicians, not a public sector system.
DoctorAI's models are named but the document does not say they are built or hosted in Rwanda by a stated actor beyond a startup product.
RISA is named only as manager of a donor programme's implementation, not as running or building systems.

facts.fact: Under the government's Rwanda Digital Acceleration Programme, backed by World Bank and AIIB finance, the Development Bank of Rwanda says it selected and funded 22 startups in 2025 and committed over EUR 1.53 million of EUR 3 million allocated, per a World Bank blog.

systems.owner: Government of Rwanda; Development Bank of Rwanda

facts.fact: Allan & Gill Gray Philanthropy Rwanda runs the 13-month JASIRI programme, which has supported 320 people and incubated 108 active firms in Rwanda, Kenya and Ethiopia, per a World Bank blog.
